purpose: Teach: 装丁/通信員/前倒し/相殺/概説/差し引い/値下がり/後ろ向き

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新カタログの装丁案を選びましょう
lines.en: Let's choose the binding design for the new catalog.
lines.style: Brisk, forward-moving. Light authority. No hesitation. The opening snap of someone who has a list and will get through it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方通信員のネットワークを強化しました
lines.en: Done. I've strengthened our network of local correspondents.
lines.style: Straightforward confirmation. A small beat of pride on the accomplishment. Calm, cooperative tone. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: スケジュールを前倒しできるよう調整しましょう
lines.en: Let's adjust the schedule so we can move things forward.
lines.style: Measured direction. Not rushed, but purposeful. Inviting participation with 'let's' — collaborative framing even in instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。買掛と売掛の相殺処理を行いました
lines.en: Done. I've processed the offset between accounts payable and accounts receivable.
lines.style: Flat, competent update. No drama. The tone of someone reporting exactly what they said they'd do. Brief.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様向けに、当社事業の概説資料を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's prepare an overview document of our business for our key clients.
lines.style: Deliberate pacing. Slight weight on 'overview' — this matters for relationships. Collaborative but clear. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。手数料を差し引いた純額を提示します
lines.en: Done. I'll present the net amount after deducting the fee.
lines.style: Factual, efficient. The tone of someone delivering numbers they've checked. No performance, just clarity.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 原料の値下がり時に大量仕入れしましょう
lines.en: When raw material prices drop, let's place a bulk order.
lines.style: Measured forward-thinking. A slight lean into the proposal — this is smart timing, and the tone says so without overselling.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の後ろ向きな声をくみ取って改善します
lines.en: Done. I'll gather feedback from staff, even the concerns, and we'll improve from there.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Slight softening here — acknowledging the people side, not just process. Genuine commitment in the delivery.
